fields.description: Parkland offers one to three bedroom apartments beside Dubai Hills Park, with the mall and business park close by. The development combines a residential tower with landscaped shared spaces, pools and sports facilities. Ground-floor terraces and first-floor homes with podium access add layout choices beyond the typical balcony apartment.

overview: The brochure pairs open living spaces with a calm interior palette, contemporary kitchens and balconies or terraces. Shared recreation extends beyond a gym and pool: padel, a multipurpose court and barbecue areas give residents several ways to use the outdoor spaces. The wider district provides the park, mall and golf club. The brochure’s energy-efficiency language is a design intention; no certification or measured saving was verified.
research.locationNote: Parkland is positioned near Dubai Hills Park, opposite the mall and business-park area in the launch material. Al Khail Road connects Dubai Hills Estate to the wider city. Check walking routes, crossings and the selected unit’s orientation rather than treating advertised proximity as a guaranteed journey time or view.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.5m. The August 2024 launch sheet lists starts of AED 1.5m, AED 2.8m and AED 4m for one, two and three bedroom apartments. These are historical category starts, not confirmation of current units at those prices.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan totals 80% before completion and 20% at completion. March 2027 and January 2028 carry 5% payments, while the other pre-completion stages are 10%. Confirm the outstanding schedule for a resale or later release.
research.handoverNote: November 2028 is the estimated completion in the launch payment document and Property Finder. Obtain the current contractual date and construction position.

facts.label: Published apartment mix
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 95 one-bedroom, 69 two-bedroom and 45 three-bedroom apartments: 209 homes in total. This is the development mix, not available inventory.

facts.label: Podium-access layout
facts.value: Three-bedroom A104 has two outdoor spaces marked with podium access, a maid’s room with bathroom, laundry and powder room. Its 1,812.97 sq ft total includes 321.30 sq ft of balcony area.

facts.label: Ground-floor comparison
facts.value: One-bedroom AG01 totals 869.19 sq ft, with a 615.48 sq ft suite and 253.71 sq ft terrace. First-floor A108 has a similar 616.99 sq ft suite but a smaller balcony, totalling 741.85 sq ft.

facts.label: Construction information is dated
facts.value: Property Finder’s progress figure is dated September 2025. It is not treated here as a current inspection, and its sold-out label does not rule out resales.
